title: French Cassoulet with Spicy Kick
description: A twist on the classic French dish, featuring the bold flavors of gochugaru and a side of crusty bread.
instructions: In a small saucepan, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add the gochugaru and cook for an additional 30 seconds.
In a large Dutch oven, combine the cassoulet, cooked garlic-gochugaru mixture, thyme, and bay leaves.
Cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the cassoulet is hot and bubbly.
Serve with crusty bread on the side.
